proposition: USAID as an interface among State, CIA, and DOD
incidental_overlap: Some same-country and same-policy overlap is incidental.
ordinary_coordination: Routine State-USAID and civil-military coordination is documented.
intentional_role_division: Parts 1-2 document an AID-led interagency security architecture; Afghanistan and stabilization doctrine intentionally combine civilian and military roles; post-OPS State/AID/DOD roles are complementary. Direct post-OPS CIA-USAID allocation is not established.
black_zebra_compartment: OPS contained covered CIA personnel, a CIA proprietary, concealed training, and Police Group liaison.
present_signatures: NSAM role allocation; Engle; IPS; ICITAP/State/AID/DOJ split; Salvadoran DOD/AID split; Afghanistan integrated strategy.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No standing post-OPS document jointly assigning USAID, CIA, and DOD roles; no universal interface.
independent_evidence_streams: Parts 1-5 archival records; statutes; GAO; NDU/DOJ; QDDR/SIGAR/GAO Afghanistan.
change_from_v1: Remains Hybrid, but deliberate Zebra architecture is now explicit rather than absorbed because no central commander exists.

proposition: Foreign assistance as an attribution and oversight mechanism
incidental_overlap: Account structure can create ordinary administrative distance and fragmented oversight.
ordinary_coordination: Appropriations, statutory restrictions, congressional notification, and OIG review are normal accountability mechanisms.
intentional_role_division: Section 660's account boundary, AID-to-DOJ transfer, interagency funding, and contractor layers intentionally assign roles through civilian authorities toward broader foreign-policy objectives.
black_zebra_compartment: ZunZuneo used concealed sponsorship, offshore entities, and contractor distance; OPS used covered/proprietary mechanisms.
present_signatures: FAA funding boundary; GAO incomplete accounting; ZunZuneo concealment; Bosnia jurisdiction gaps; OIG oversight trail.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No government-wide instruction defining aid as a standard deniability vehicle; many programs were openly authorized and reviewed.
independent_evidence_streams: Statutes; GAO; USAID OIG/Senate; HRW/CID-derived record; Parts 1-2 CIA records.
change_from_v1: Still Hybrid, now because ordinary oversight and deliberate attribution management both materially exist.

proposition: Deliberate division of funding, policy, and operations
incidental_overlap: The resulting wider effect was not merely incidental.
ordinary_coordination: Agency competence explains why State handles diplomacy and Justice law enforcement.
intentional_role_division: AID funded, State guided policy, Justice operated, and host governments received; the institutional history describes a conscious compromise shaped by law, capacity, and OPS reputational risk.
black_zebra_compartment: No covert ICITAP compartment is documented.
present_signatures: Direct AID-to-DOJ transfer; State policy role; Justice operating role; separate recipient; later contractor implementation.
missing_or_counter_signatures: Founding agreement missing; no evidence of concealed master agency or false public purpose.
independent_evidence_streams: GAO; statutes; NDU history; DOJ milestones.
change_from_v1: Moved from Hybrid to Zebra because explicit complementary role allocation is itself the diagnostic signature.

incidental_overlap: Some political effects of civic programs are incidental or inherent in participation work.
ordinary_coordination: Overt democracy and transition programs normally seek political reform and network building.
intentional_role_division: OTI and democracy programs intentionally build civic, media, activist, and institutional capacity toward political-transition objectives; ZunZuneo intentionally built a politically useful audience.
black_zebra_compartment: ZunZuneo concealed sponsorship; Bangladesh's alleged destabilization language is unauthenticated.
present_signatures: OTI political mandate; ZunZuneo audience/segmentation plan; uncontested Bangladesh cultural outputs.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No broad grant-level map; no authenticated Bangladesh sentence; no proof of directed regime-change operations across civil society.
independent_evidence_streams: USAID OIG independent of interview; contested Bangladesh file not primary proof; interview is one lead stream.
change_from_v1: Remains Hybrid, but overt deliberate political network-building now counts as Zebra evidence rather than only emergent strategic value.

proposition: Contractors and NGOs as intermediary layers
incidental_overlap: Much outsourcing reflects capacity, expertise, and local access.
ordinary_coordination: Contracts and grants are normal implementation mechanisms.
intentional_role_division: Creative, DynCorp, and ICITAP contractors were intentionally assigned operational roles inside broader government programs; organizational distance and flexibility were functional features.
black_zebra_compartment: Creative's ZunZuneo structure used offshore entities and concealed sponsorship; no equivalent Black Zebra evidence applies to DynCorp generally.
present_signatures: Creative implementation; DynCorp's separate State/DOD roles; ICITAP contractor expansion; accountability fragmentation.
missing_or_counter_signatures: Incomplete contract/subaward chains; no basis for classifying every intermediary as a cutout.
independent_evidence_streams: USAID OIG; NDU; HRW/CID-derived record; DOJ.
change_from_v1: Remains Hybrid because both ordinary outsourcing and deliberately attribution-sensitive intermediation are substantial.

proposition: Information generated by ostensibly civilian programs
incidental_overlap: Some information is an ordinary byproduct of monitoring, surveys, journalism, or subscriber management.
ordinary_coordination: Agencies normally share relevant information under lawful coordination.
intentional_role_division: OPS/IPA deliberately routed participant information and assessments; ZunZuneo deliberately sought political-receptivity data; anti-corruption programs intentionally generate actionable public information.
black_zebra_compartment: OPS/IPS information access occurred inside covered/proprietary architecture; ZunZuneo concealed its sponsor while gathering audience data.
present_signatures: Trainee biographies/orientation assessments; Police Group liaison; ZunZuneo segmentation; journalism outcome metrics.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No general post-OPS civilian-to-intelligence pipeline; no documented intelligence customer for OCCRP; ZunZuneo data yield was weak.
independent_evidence_streams: Parts 1-2 CIA/OPS records; USAID OIG; media evidence remains largely one lead stream.
change_from_v1: Remains Hybrid, now distinguishing intentional information production from proven intelligence dissemination.

incidental_overlap: Some benefit can arise incidentally from publicly available or routine partner information.
ordinary_coordination: Source deconfliction and liaison are ordinary intelligence-law-enforcement coordination.
intentional_role_division: CIA/DEA source registry, station-chief notification, regional centers, and OPS liaison intentionally allocate information roles around shared security objectives without requiring ownership.
black_zebra_compartment: TWO-FOLD and OPS/IPS contained covert recruitment, covered personnel, proprietaries, and concealed channels.
present_signatures: Formal source coordination; intelligence-community presence in narcotics centers; foreign liaison described as vital; historical participant routing.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No CIA ownership of ICITAP, ZunZuneo, ILEA, or the whole post-OPS network.
independent_evidence_streams: Declassified CIA records; Parts 1-2 and Part 5 archival streams; statutes/GAO contextual streams.
change_from_v1: Moved from Hybrid to Zebra; lack of ownership is compatible with deliberately networked statecraft.

incidental_overlap: Continued demand alone explains some later similarity.
ordinary_coordination: Congress openly created exceptions and agencies lawfully developed new programs.
intentional_role_division: Functions were intentionally reassigned through narcotics exceptions, AID-to-DOJ funding, new agency homes, post-conflict authority, personnel bridges, and contractors after OPS became unavailable.
black_zebra_compartment: TWO-FOLD's selective foreign continuation and earlier Laos handoff contain covert/covered elements; ICITAP migration itself was overt.
present_signatures: OPS closure; statutory exceptions; ICITAP handoff; Kriskovich; 125-country aggregate; explicit OPS-to-DEA Laos transition.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No en bloc successor; no complete alumni trail; no single design document for the entire ecosystem.
independent_evidence_streams: Statutes; GAO 1976/1992; NDU/DOJ; Parts 1-5 archival records.
change_from_v1: Moved from Hybrid to Zebra because deliberate reassignment, not central command, is the decisive fact.

incidental_overlap: Commercial audience-building and public diplomacy explain some tactics.
ordinary_coordination: USAID/OTI normally conducts political-transition and closed-society programming.
intentional_role_division: OTI, Creative, grant vehicles, offshore structures, content acquisition, and audience segmentation were intentionally combined to produce a political-influence capability.
black_zebra_compartment: Concealed U.S. sponsorship, offshore shell structure, indirect ownership, and attribution management satisfy Black Zebra signatures even without a legal covert-action finding.

missing_or_counter_signatures: No CIA tasking; broad congressional notification; no fraud finding; little useful profiling; no executed smart mobs shown.
independent_evidence_streams: USAID OIG; Senate hearing partially shares underlying record; interview adds no independent proof.
change_from_v1: Moved from Hybrid to Black Zebra; analytical concealment criteria are met even though OIG did not make a formal covert-action determination.

ordinary_coordination: New law and agency competence explain much of its design.
intentional_role_division: Congressional authority, AID money, State policy, Justice operations, FBI personnel, recipient governments, and later contractors were intentionally assembled around a common police-development objective.
black_zebra_compartment: No Black Zebra compartment is documented for ICITAP.
present_signatures: AID transfer; State guidance; DOJ operation; Kriskovich; management/academy/post-conflict expansion.
missing_or_counter_signatures: Institutionally new and initially narrower; no OPS corporate succession; no CIA tasking; missing founding agreement.
change_from_v1: Moved from Hybrid to Zebra; overt and legitimate deliberately networked statecraft still qualifies.

ordinary_coordination: Routine source coordination and intelligence support are documented.
intentional_role_division: CIA and BNDD/DEA intentionally divided recruitment, training, collection, liaison, and law-enforcement roles around foreign narcotics objectives.
black_zebra_compartment: TWO-FOLD used covert recruitment and proprietary cover; covered agents and selective secret continuation satisfy Black Zebra criteria.
present_signatures: CIA training; TWO-FOLD; seven-officer transfer; source registry; station-chief notification; intelligence centers; prosecution/secrecy conflict.

incidental_overlap: Policy failure, conflicting goals, and one shared theater explain some overlap.
ordinary_coordination: Interagency counterinsurgency and stabilization planning is ordinary wartime coordination.
intentional_role_division: USAID development, DOD security, State policy, counternarcotics, PRTs, and alternative livelihoods were deliberately assembled as a combined counterinsurgency/stabilization toolkit.
black_zebra_compartment: No Black Zebra compartment is established in the retained Afghanistan evidence.
present_signatures: Strategy explicitly aligned counternarcotics with counterinsurgency; eradication de-emphasized; DOD role expanded; PRT/civil-military doctrine; large alternative-development portfolio.
missing_or_counter_signatures: No intent to sustain heroin; no CIA tasking; serious incoherence and poor understanding show that not every effect was orchestrated.
independent_evidence_streams: GAO; SIGAR; QDDR; military doctrine; USIP secondary stream.
change_from_v1: Moved from Hybrid to Zebra; explicit integrated strategy outweighs the absence of central control, while failures remain emergent.

incidental_overlap: Independent journalism and normal downstream consequences may explain the observed outcomes.

intentional_role_division: A Zebra finding would require award terms, approval rights, target selection, prosecutor links, or country strategies assigning journalism a strategic role; current corpus only hints at this through outcome metrics.
black_zebra_compartment: No covert funding, cutout, or false-attribution evidence is authenticated in the retained corpus.
present_signatures: Reported USAID outcome metrics; OCCRP's production of politically consequential information; identifiable funding lead.
missing_or_counter_signatures: Underlying factsheet blocked; no contract terms, editorial direction, targeting evidence, or complete funding chain.
independent_evidence_streams: Interview and its summary of the factsheet are one stream; no second primary operational stream.
change_from_v1: Moved from Horse/Hybrid-open to Unresolved because the corrected Zebra test requires role-allocation evidence that has not yet been acquired.
